cues: Every impossible thing is described in the flattest everyday terms.
A man with wings, and he has lice.
A woman turned into a spider, and she is cheaper to see.
Healing miracles, and they are consolation prizes.
Because nobody in the story truly marvels, we see clearly what ordinary people do with a marvel, and that is the satire.
